units.id: mission:Curious Waiter|On a whim, you decide to dine in at a restaurant well clear of the busy spaceport. You swiftly find yourself searching up a list of delicacies on a physical menu as people stream past the window by your booth, each looking drained from the long work day. Meal soon ordered, you continue watching the crowd until it arrives, a local version of a katsu don and dig in.|225|0
units.english: On a whim, you decide to dine in at a restaurant well clear of the busy spaceport. You swiftly find yourself searching up a list of delicacies on a physical menu as people stream past the window by your booth, each looking drained from the long work day. Meal soon ordered, you continue watching the crowd until it arrives, a local version of a katsu don and dig in.
units.italian: Per un capriccio decidi di cenare in un ristorante lontano dallo spazioporto affollato. Ti ritrovi presto a scorrere un elenco di prelibatezze su un menù cartaceo mentre la gente passa davanti alla vetrina accanto al tuo tavolo, tutti con l'aria provata da una lunga giornata di lavoro. Ordinata presto la cena, continui a guardare la folla finché non arriva, una versione locale del katsu don, e ti metti a mangiare.

units.id: mission:Curious Waiter|	The place is quiet, perhaps a little early for the dinner rush yet, and you are halfway through your meal when a waiter stops beside you, coughing to catch your attention.|226|0
units.english: The place is quiet, perhaps a little early for the dinner rush yet, and you are halfway through your meal when a waiter stops beside you, coughing to catch your attention.
units.italian: Il locale è silenzioso, forse è ancora presto per l'ora di punta della cena, e sei a metà del pasto quando un cameriere si ferma accanto a te e tossisce per attirare la tua attenzione.

units.id: mission:Curious Waiter|	"May I help you?"|228|0
units.english: "May I help you?"
units.italian: "Posso aiutarla?"

units.id: mission:Curious Waiter|	"Yes?"|229|0
units.english: "Yes?"
units.italian: "Sì?"

units.id: mission:Curious Waiter|	"What do you want?"|230|0
units.english: "What do you want?"
units.italian: "Cosa vuole?"

units.id: mission:Curious Waiter|	"Sorry," he says, grabbing the edges of his shirt. "But... may I ask... what's it like to see the stars? To visit other worlds?"|231|0
units.english: "Sorry," he says, grabbing the edges of his shirt. "But... may I ask... what's it like to see the stars? To visit other worlds?"
units.italian: "Mi scusi", dice, afferrando i lembi della camicia. "Ma... posso chiedere... com'è vedere le stelle? Visitare altri mondi?"

units.id: mission:Curious Waiter|	"Most worlds are the same or worse than here."|233|0
units.english: "Most worlds are the same or worse than here."
units.italian: "La maggior parte dei mondi è uguale a questo, o peggio."

units.id: mission:Curious Waiter|	"The stars are prettier under an atmosphere."|234|0
units.english: "The stars are prettier under an atmosphere."
units.italian: "Le stelle sono più belle sotto un'atmosfera."

units.id: mission:Curious Waiter|	"It's an adventure, but not for the faint of heart."|235|0
units.english: "It's an adventure, but not for the faint of heart."
units.italian: "È un'avventura, ma non per i deboli di cuore."

units.id: mission:Curious Waiter|	"Oh... I've never seen any pilots, so I never got to ask," he says, slightly dejected. "Thank you very much for telling me though!"|236|0
units.english: "Oh... I've never seen any pilots, so I never got to ask," he says, slightly dejected. "Thank you very much for telling me though!"
units.italian: "Oh... non ho mai visto nessun pilota, quindi non ho mai potuto chiedere", dice, un po' abbattuto. "Grazie mille però per avermelo raccontato!"

units.id: mission:Curious Waiter|	He goes back to his work, with a thoughtful expression of neutral satisfaction on his face.|237|0
units.english: He goes back to his work, with a thoughtful expression of neutral satisfaction on his face.
units.italian: Torna al suo lavoro, con un'espressione pensierosa di neutra soddisfazione sul viso.

units.id: mission:Syndicated Security Troops|The low rumble of "Tonners," heavy trucks for moving troops and supplies, rolling down the street causes heads to turn and look at the blocky yet imposing vehicles slowing to a stop. The driver and the commander of the foremost vehicle have their eyes on the road, watching out for any traffic hazards that might pose a risk to either the vehicle or their support.|253|0
units.english: The low rumble of "Tonners," heavy trucks for moving troops and supplies, rolling down the street causes heads to turn and look at the blocky yet imposing vehicles slowing to a stop. The driver and the commander of the foremost vehicle have their eyes on the road, watching out for any traffic hazards that might pose a risk to either the vehicle or their support.
units.italian: Il rombo basso dei "Tonner", i camion pesanti per spostare truppe e rifornimenti, che scendono lungo la strada, fa voltare le teste verso i veicoli massicci ma imponenti che rallentano fino a fermarsi. Il conducente e il comandante del veicolo di testa tengono gli occhi sulla strada, attenti a qualsiasi pericolo del traffico che possa minacciare il veicolo o la loro scorta.

units.id: mission:Syndicated Security Troops|	The troops within the back of each tonner, on the other hand, are making small talk, the camo on their face smearing off in the heat. One of them points at you, saying something that garners him a groan from his peers, and you decided that you probably don't want to know what he said.|254|0
units.english: The troops within the back of each tonner, on the other hand, are making small talk, the camo on their face smearing off in the heat. One of them points at you, saying something that garners him a groan from his peers, and you decided that you probably don't want to know what he said.
units.italian: Le truppe nel retro di ogni tonner, invece, fanno conversazione, con il camuffamento sul viso che si scioglie per il caldo. Uno di loro ti indica, dicendo qualcosa che gli guadagna un gemito dei compagni, e decidi che probabilmente non vuoi sapere cosa ha detto.

units.id: mission:Class Trip to Port|A group of children waves at you as you step off your ship, marveling at the spacecraft on display as their teachers try and fail to hold their attention. You can see the fading of their uniform colors from afar as their group walks past, yet none of them look one bit displeased. While you make your way into the spaceport itself, you wonder how many of them may eventually own their own spaceship and fly across the stars.|269|0
units.english: A group of children waves at you as you step off your ship, marveling at the spacecraft on display as their teachers try and fail to hold their attention. You can see the fading of their uniform colors from afar as their group walks past, yet none of them look one bit displeased. While you make your way into the spaceport itself, you wonder how many of them may eventually own their own spaceship and fly across the stars.
units.italian: Un gruppo di bambini ti saluta con la mano mentre scendi dalla nave, meravigliati dal veicolo spaziale in mostra mentre le loro insegnanti cercano senza successo di tenere la loro attenzione. Da lontano vedi sbiadire i colori delle loro divise mentre il gruppo passa, e nessuno di loro sembra minimamente scontento. Mentre ti avvii verso lo spazioporto, ti chiedi quanti di loro finiranno per avere una nave propria e volare tra le stelle.

units.id: mission:Old Defense Turrets|With an annoyingly long stopover having encouraged you to do a little exploring, you rent a car for a short drive around the immediate area. Later, as you pull the car into the designated return parking lot, the unexpected sound of large hydraulic motors draws your attention. You watch as a massive turret lifts up from behind a nearby barricade and turns toward the sky, its single cannon poised to fire at seemingly nothing.|284|0
units.english: With an annoyingly long stopover having encouraged you to do a little exploring, you rent a car for a short drive around the immediate area. Later, as you pull the car into the designated return parking lot, the unexpected sound of large hydraulic motors draws your attention. You watch as a massive turret lifts up from behind a nearby barricade and turns toward the sky, its single cannon poised to fire at seemingly nothing.
units.italian: Una sosta fastidiosamente lunga ti ha spinto a esplorare un po', così noleggi un'auto per un breve giro nei dintorni. Più tardi, mentre infili l'auto nel parcheggio designato per la riconsegna, il rumore inatteso di grandi motori idraulici attira la tua attenzione. Guardi una torretta enorme sollevarsi da dietro una barricata vicina e voltarsi verso il cielo, con il suo unico cannone pronto a sparare contro apparentemente nulla.

units.id: mission:Old Defense Turrets|	Looking around for some form of explanation you find a plaque placed conveniently nearby dedicating the turret, and five others like it, offering protection and discouraging piracy until relatively recent years. You can't help but wonder how well the turrets would do if they were to be actually used again.|285|0
units.english: Looking around for some form of explanation you find a plaque placed conveniently nearby dedicating the turret, and five others like it, offering protection and discouraging piracy until relatively recent years. You can't help but wonder how well the turrets would do if they were to be actually used again.
units.italian: Cercando in giro una qualche spiegazione, trovi una targa sistemata lì vicino in modo comodo che dedica la torretta, e altre cinque come lei, offrendo protezione e scoraggiando la pirateria fino ad anni relativamente recenti. Non puoi fare a meno di chiederti come se la caverebbero le torrette se venissero davvero usate di nuovo.

units.id: mission:Blind Landing|Smog fills your windscreen as you make your descent, trying and failing to see anything more than a few meters in front of you. The autopilot systems show solid green across the full range of indicators though, and traffic control has confirmed a lock.|304|0
units.english: Smog fills your windscreen as you make your descent, trying and failing to see anything more than a few meters in front of you. The autopilot systems show solid green across the full range of indicators though, and traffic control has confirmed a lock.
units.italian: Lo smog riempie il parabrezza mentre scendi, cercando senza successo di vedere qualcosa oltre a pochi metri davanti a te. I sistemi di pilota automatico però mostrano verde pieno su tutta la gamma di indicatori, e il controllo del traffico ha confermato l'aggancio.

units.id: mission:Blind Landing|	(Land on autopilot.)|306|0
units.english: (Land on autopilot.)
units.italian: (Atterra con il pilota automatico.)

units.id: mission:Blind Landing|	(Return to orbit.)|307|0
units.english: (Return to orbit.)
units.italian: (Torna in orbita.)

units.id: mission:Blind Landing|	You let the craft perform the landing, staring blankly at the haze until it clears.|309|0
units.english: You let the craft perform the landing, staring blankly at the haze until it clears.
units.italian: Lasci che il mezzo esegua l'atterraggio, fissando la foschia senza vederci nulla finché non si dirada.

units.id: mission:Blind Landing|	On the ground, you see the cause, fields upon fields of plantations burning. You see a crowd of mostly farmers blocking off a smaller group of firefighters, arguing and trying to stop them from putting out the flames as planes fly overhead, dropping water and retardants wherever necessary.|310|0
units.english: On the ground, you see the cause, fields upon fields of plantations burning. You see a crowd of mostly farmers blocking off a smaller group of firefighters, arguing and trying to stop them from putting out the flames as planes fly overhead, dropping water and retardants wherever necessary.
units.italian: A terra ne vedi la causa: campi e campi di piantagioni in fiamme. Vedi una folla in gran parte di agricoltori che blocca un gruppo più piccolo di vigili del fuoco, discutendo e cercando di impedire loro di spegnere le fiamme, mentre gli aerei passano sopra scaricando acqua e ritardanti dove serve.

units.id: mission:Blind Landing|	You recall seeing something like this years ago, of farmers burning their crops to make the land fertile, and how bad the air was for months.|311|0
units.english: You recall seeing something like this years ago, of farmers burning their crops to make the land fertile, and how bad the air was for months.
units.italian: Ricordi di aver visto qualcosa del genere anni fa: agricoltori che bruciavano i raccolti per rendere fertile la terra, e quanto fosse cattiva l'aria per mesi.

units.id: mission:Blind Landing|	Unwilling to trust landing blind into an unknown situation, you return to orbit and rejoin the spaceport processing queue. One day of delay is a worthwhile price to pay for surety.|314|0
units.english: Unwilling to trust landing blind into an unknown situation, you return to orbit and rejoin the spaceport processing queue. One day of delay is a worthwhile price to pay for surety.
units.italian: Non volendo fidarti di un atterraggio alla cieca in una situazione sconosciuta, torni in orbita e rientri nella coda di smistamento dello spazioporto. Un giorno di ritardo è un prezzo che vale la certezza.

units.id: mission:Forest Fire|The smell of burning smoke permeates the air as you step off your craft, causing you to rush towards the nearest shelter, coughing along the way. Once there, you find people shouting and rushing about to get tape plastered onto the windows. No one seems to have noticed your arrival and none give an explanation.|330|0
units.english: The smell of burning smoke permeates the air as you step off your craft, causing you to rush towards the nearest shelter, coughing along the way. Once there, you find people shouting and rushing about to get tape plastered onto the windows. No one seems to have noticed your arrival and none give an explanation.
units.italian: L'odore di fumo bruciato impregna l'aria mentre scendi dal mezzo, facendoti correre verso il riparo più vicino, tossendo per la strada. Una volta lì, trovi gente che urla e si affanna a incollare nastro adesivo sulle finestre. Nessuno sembra aver notato il tuo arrivo e nessuno dà spiegazioni.

units.id: mission:Forest Fire|	"Hey! What's happening? I can help!"|332|0
units.english: "Hey! What's happening? I can help!"
units.italian: "Ehi! Cosa succede? Posso aiutare!"

units.id: mission:Forest Fire|	(Look for someone not in motion.)|334|0
units.english: (Look for someone not in motion.)
units.italian: (Cerca qualcuno che non stia correndo.)

units.id: mission:Forest Fire|	You seek out a pregnant lady sitting on a chair, a mask worn as she explains: "A large fire has sprung up nearby, and the wind is fanning it towards the spaceport. Might have been some fool playing with fire, or some pirate sending a message to a local. We don't know, could be anything around here really. We're hunkering down and hoping it'll burn out before it does too much damage."|335|0
units.english: You seek out a pregnant lady sitting on a chair, a mask worn as she explains: "A large fire has sprung up nearby, and the wind is fanning it towards the spaceport. Might have been some fool playing with fire, or some pirate sending a message to a local. We don't know, could be anything around here really. We're hunkering down and hoping it'll burn out before it does too much damage."
units.italian: Cerchi una donna incinta seduta su una sedia, con una maschera addosso, che spiega: "È scoppiato un grande incendio qui vicino, e il vento lo sta spingendo verso lo spazioporto. Potrebbe essere stato qualche sciocco che giocava col fuoco, o qualche pirata che manda un messaggio a un locale. Non lo sappiamo, qui può essere qualsiasi cosa davvero. Ci stiamo barricando e speriamo che si spenga prima di fare troppi danni."

units.id: mission:Forest Fire|	"I have a ship out there. Let me help."|337|0
units.english: "I have a ship out there. Let me help."
units.italian: "Ho una nave là fuori. Lasciami aiutare."

units.id: mission:Forest Fire|	Her eyes widen and she looks around, sharply catching the attention of one of the many people hurrying about.|338|0
units.english: Her eyes widen and she looks around, sharply catching the attention of one of the many people hurrying about.
units.italian: Le si spalancano gli occhi e si guarda intorno, attirando bruscamente l'attenzione di una delle tante persone che si affannano.

units.id: mission:Forest Fire|	A young man who looks suspiciously like he might've been air traffic control twenty minutes ago glances at you and skids to a stop. "Oh, you're a pilot! Can your ship help?"|341|0
units.english: A young man who looks suspiciously like he might've been air traffic control twenty minutes ago glances at you and skids to a stop. "Oh, you're a pilot! Can your ship help?"
units.italian: Un giovane che sospetti fosse al controllo del traffico aereo venti minuti fa ti guarda e frena di colpo. "Oh, sei un pilota! La tua nave può aiutare?"

units.id: mission:Forest Fire|	"Yes."|343|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Forest Fire|	The dock-hands scramble to get the firefighting equipment onto your ship after your proclamation, instructing you to drop the retardants onto the perimeter of the fire. You barely manage to remember what every button does before the Air Traffic Controller clears you to depart, navigating your craft towards the fire.|345|0
units.english: The dock-hands scramble to get the firefighting equipment onto your ship after your proclamation, instructing you to drop the retardants onto the perimeter of the fire. You barely manage to remember what every button does before the Air Traffic Controller clears you to depart, navigating your craft towards the fire.
units.italian: Dopo la tua dichiarazione gli addetti al molo si affannano a caricare l'attrezzatura antincendio sulla nave, istruendoti a sganciare i ritardanti sul perimetro dell'incendio. Riesci a malapena a ricordare cosa fa ogni pulsante prima che il controllore del traffico aereo ti dia il via, e dirigi il mezzo verso le fiamme.

units.id: mission:Forest Fire|	The raging fire flares like an inferno, throwing up black smoke in deep billowing waves as you approach. As you drop the retardants, making sure to keep your speed low, animals scramble towards safer grounds. You try to make sure you've not emptied right on top of them each time as you go back for another batch.|346|0
units.english: The raging fire flares like an inferno, throwing up black smoke in deep billowing waves as you approach. As you drop the retardants, making sure to keep your speed low, animals scramble towards safer grounds. You try to make sure you've not emptied right on top of them each time as you go back for another batch.
units.italian: L'incendio infuria come un inferno e solleva fumo nero in ondate profonde mentre ti avvicini. Mentre lasci cadere i ritardanti, attento a tenere bassa la velocità, gli animali scappano verso terreni più sicuri. Cerchi di assicurarti di non aver svuotato il carico proprio sopra di loro ogni volta che torni per un altro giro.

units.id: mission:Forest Fire|	Hours later, you look at your handiwork, a long line of red keeping back the flames as the fire starts to smother out. You radio your progress and receive a cheery response, thanking you for your help.|347|0
units.english: Hours later, you look at your handiwork, a long line of red keeping back the flames as the fire starts to smother out. You radio your progress and receive a cheery response, thanking you for your help.
units.italian: Ore dopo guardi il tuo lavoro: una lunga linea rossa che trattiene le fiamme mentre l'incendio comincia a spegnersi. Comunichi i tuoi progressi via radio e ricevi una risposta allegra che ti ringrazia per l'aiuto.

units.id: mission:Local Politics|As you land on the pad, you note a general lack of presence around the spaceport. No one has scrambled to hook up your ship, nor has anybody else acknowledged your arrival. Instead, when you leave your ship, all you find is a note within the spaceport detailing where their "overlords" can find their yearly tribute.|372|0
units.english: As you land on the pad, you note a general lack of presence around the spaceport. No one has scrambled to hook up your ship, nor has anybody else acknowledged your arrival. Instead, when you leave your ship, all you find is a note within the spaceport detailing where their "overlords" can find their yearly tribute.
units.italian: Mentre atterri sulla piattaforma noti un'assenza generale intorno allo spazioporto. Nessuno si è precipitato ad agganciare la nave, né qualcun altro ha riconosciuto il tuo arrivo. Invece, quando esci dalla nave, trovi solo un biglietto nello spazioporto che spiega dove i loro "signori" possono trovare il tributo annuale.

units.id: mission:Local Politics|	You decide against finding out where the inhabitants went.|373|0
units.english: You decide against finding out where the inhabitants went.
units.italian: Decidi di non scoprire dove siano finiti gli abitanti.

units.id: mission:Military Response Test|In a strange set of instructions, the Air Traffic Controller has you punch in a set of coordinates, taking you close to a massive military base on the way to the landing zone. You let the autopilot take over as you watch the view off the cockpit window, hoping the turrets in the base won't shoot you out of the sky.|389|0
units.english: In a strange set of instructions, the Air Traffic Controller has you punch in a set of coordinates, taking you close to a massive military base on the way to the landing zone. You let the autopilot take over as you watch the view off the cockpit window, hoping the turrets in the base won't shoot you out of the sky.
units.italian: Con una serie di istruzioni strana, il controllore del traffico aereo ti fa inserire un insieme di coordinate che ti porta vicino a un'enorme base militare lungo la strada per la zona di atterraggio. Lasci fare al pilota automatico mentre guardi il panorama dal finestrino, sperando che le torrette della base non ti sparino giù.

units.id: mission:Military Response Test|	From where you are watching, you see a single woman standing within the parade square, a hand raised like she's looking at her watch. Seconds pass before she raises her other hand and gives a thumbs up to whoever's looking at her. Suddenly, a loud siren sounds out across the base that is audible even in your ship as it passes by at reasonable height. You watch as soldiers drop everything they're doing, some rushing into buildings while others run toward armored vehicles. Within minutes, the base's vehicles are rolling towards the parade square whilst soldiers in full gear run to assemble within the square in neat rows.|390|0
units.english: From where you are watching, you see a single woman standing within the parade square, a hand raised like she's looking at her watch. Seconds pass before she raises her other hand and gives a thumbs up to whoever's looking at her. Suddenly, a loud siren sounds out across the base that is audible even in your ship as it passes by at reasonable height. You watch as soldiers drop everything they're doing, some rushing into buildings while others run toward armored vehicles. Within minutes, the base's vehicles are rolling towards the parade square whilst soldiers in full gear run to assemble within the square in neat rows.
units.italian: Da dove guardi, vedi una donna sola in piedi nel piazzale della parata, con una mano alzata come se guardasse l'orologio. Passano secondi prima che alzi l'altra mano e faccia un pollice in su a chiunque la stia guardando. All'improvviso una sirena forte risuona su tutta la base, udibile anche dalla nave che passa a quota ragionevole. Guardi i soldati lasciare cadere tutto quello che stanno facendo: alcuni corrono negli edifici, altri verso i veicoli corazzati. In pochi minuti i veicoli della base rotolano verso il piazzale mentre i soldati in equipaggiamento completo corrono a schierarsi in file ordinate.

units.id: mission:Military Response Test|	You aren't sure whether what they were doing was scheduled, or if it was in response to your flight.|391|0
units.english: You aren't sure whether what they were doing was scheduled, or if it was in response to your flight.
units.italian: Non sei sicuro se quello che facevano fosse in programma o una risposta al tuo volo.

units.id: mission:Missed Mugging|The sun has already set when you walk out of the spaceport, trying to find a nearby restaurant to sample their wares. Looking around, the only source of light comes from the building you just exited, a beacon within the sea of darkness.|406|0
units.english: The sun has already set when you walk out of the spaceport, trying to find a nearby restaurant to sample their wares. Looking around, the only source of light comes from the building you just exited, a beacon within the sea of darkness.
units.italian: Il sole è già tramontato quando esci dallo spazioporto, cercando un ristorante vicino per assaggiare quello che offrono. Guardandoti intorno, l'unica fonte di luce viene dall'edificio da cui sei appena uscito, un faro in mezzo a un mare di buio.

units.id: mission:Missed Mugging|	Choosing a random direction, you decide to walk down the quiet street, taking in the sights. You are interrupted as two men rush from an alley, pushing past you as they go. Before you can respond, you see a woman run out, clothes in disarray as she gives chase to the two men to no avail. Belatedly, you realize that they were holding a purse, long after they've disappeared, melting into the blackness beyond.|407|0
units.english: Choosing a random direction, you decide to walk down the quiet street, taking in the sights. You are interrupted as two men rush from an alley, pushing past you as they go. Before you can respond, you see a woman run out, clothes in disarray as she gives chase to the two men to no avail. Belatedly, you realize that they were holding a purse, long after they've disappeared, melting into the blackness beyond.
units.italian: Scegliendo una direzione a caso, decidi di percorrere la strada silenziosa, godendoti la vista. Vieni interrotto quando due uomini sbucano da un vicolo e ti passano accanto spingendoti. Prima che tu possa reagire, vedi una donna uscire di corsa, con i vestiti in disordine, che insegue i due senza successo. Solo in ritardo capisci che avevano una borsetta, molto dopo che sono spariti, dissolti nel nero oltre.

units.id: mission:Sojourn Sunday Sales|You blink in surprise as you enter the spaceport, watching throngs of people pushing their way through the human chains of queues wrapped around the commercial area. You scan your surroundings and notice advertisements upon advertisements of vacation locations, all at an absurdly high discount. Yet despite their vastly reduced prices, the advertised holidays still cost such large sums that a younger you could never have justified such expense.|423|0
units.english: You blink in surprise as you enter the spaceport, watching throngs of people pushing their way through the human chains of queues wrapped around the commercial area. You scan your surroundings and notice advertisements upon advertisements of vacation locations, all at an absurdly high discount. Yet despite their vastly reduced prices, the advertised holidays still cost such large sums that a younger you could never have justified such expense.
units.italian: Entri nello spazioporto e socchiudi gli occhi per la sorpresa, guardando folle di persone che si fanno largo tra le catene umane di code avvolte intorno all'area commerciale. Scansionando l'ambiente noti inserzioni su inserzioni di località di vacanza, tutte a uno sconto assurdamente alto. Eppure, nonostante i prezzi molto ridotti, le vacanze pubblicizzate costano ancora somme così grandi che un te più giovane non avrebbe mai potuto giustificare una spesa simile.
